summary_en: Management update on capital-cost and stock-price-aware management initiatives. Board resolution dated 2026-06-19 reflects current-state analysis and improvement measures. Detailed metrics and targets in attached presentation.
title_en: Initiatives toward the realization of management conscious of capital costs and stock prices (Update)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-19, COSEL's board of directors approved an update to its capital-cost and stock-price-aware management initiatives. The disclosure constitutes a status review and announcement of improvement measures and implementation progress, with detailed targets and metrics contained in the attached presentation. No specific quantitative targets, payout-ratio floors, or execution timelines are disclosed in the press release header; the full terms are reserved for the supplementary materials.
